newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ENSKILDA DECLINES COMMENT ON HANSA MERGER REPORT.
newsitem.headline: ENSKILDA DECLINES COMMENT ON HANSA MERGER REPORT.

text.p: Sweden's Skandinviska Enskilda Banken (SE Banken) declined on Thursday to comment on a report in Estonia's Eesti Ekspress which said that it had held merger negotiations with Hansapank .
"We never comment on rumours or newspaper articles," a spokeswoman for SE Banken told Reuters on Thursday.

Estonian weekly Eesti Ekspress said on Thursday that Hansapank and SE Banken held merger negotations earlier in the year and that the Swedish bank was interested in buying up to 40 percent of Hansapank.
The paper added that the talks were now suspended.
No response to the report was immediately available from Hansapank.
Hansapank is the leading bank in the Baltic states.
